subject: Operations
title: Poka-Yoke: Mistake-Proofing
description: A quick, practical guide to Poka-Yoke: Mistake-Proofing.

hook.text: A USB plug only fits one way. That's poka-yoke—designing the error out so it physically can't happen.

buildup.text: Shigeo Shingo invented poka-yoke at Toyota. The goal: make mistakes impossible or instantly obvious.

discovery.text: Examples are everywhere: car doors that beep when keys are inside, gas caps tethered so they can't be lost.

twist.text: Training people to avoid errors works sometimes. Designing errors out works every time.

climax.text: Hospitals use color-coded syringes and forced checklists—poka-yoke saves lives, not just products.

quiz.question: What is the goal of poka-yoke?
